1  high  A DKIM RSA key is shorter than 1024 bits (example.com) [email.dkim_key_breakable]
   Subject       selector google (google-workspace) on example.com (dkim_selector
                 google._domainkey.example.com)
   Observed      dkim1 (07:12, as anonymous): DKIM at google._domainkey.example.com; RSA modulus 512
                 bits
   Severity      high
   Why here      You declared selector google for google-workspace.
   Not checked   Whether this selector signs current mail and whether that mail aligns were not
                 assessed
   Fix           Rotate to a 2048-bit RSA key at your sender, publish its new selector, verify
                 delivery, then retire the old key.

2  medium  An administrator is not among the declared expected administrators (Workspace)
   [identity.unexpected_admin]
   Subject       admin@example.com (account admin@example.com)
   You declared  engagement.yaml access.admins: Operator declaration at access.admins
   Observed      g000008 (07:12, as unknown): admin@example.com is a super administrator attributed
                 to declared person alice, who is absent from the expected administrator list
   Concluded from request:g000008, declared:access.admins
   Severity      medium
   Why here      This is the standard rating for the observed access or settings.
   Fix           Confirm whether the person needs full administrator access; remove it or correct
                 the expected administrator declaration.

3  medium  Google reports no account sign-in for more than 90 days (Workspace)
   [workspace.stale_account]
   Subject       admin@example.com (account admin@example.com)
   Observed      g000014 (07:12, as unknown): Google reports no sign-in since 2026-01-01T00:00:00Z.
                 Sessions and application activity were not reviewed.
   Severity      medium
   Why here      This is the standard rating for the observed access or settings.
   Fix           Confirm whether this account is needed before suspending it; review its sessions
                 and application grants.

5  low  DMARC publishes a partial percentage for legacy receivers (example.com)
   [email.dmarc_partial]
   Subject       example.com (declared sending: google-workspace) (mail_domain example.com)
   Observed      dmarc1 (07:12, as anonymous): DMARC p=reject; legacy pct=25; test mode=false
   Severity      low
   Why here      You listed google-workspace as sending for example.com. DNS does not show whether
                 it sends current mail.
   Not checked   Actual receiver enforcement and message alignment were not assessed
   Fix           Verify each legitimate sender in DMARC reports, then remove pct or set it to 100.

6  low  SPF includes a service absent from the declared senders (example.com)
   [email.spf_undeclared_sender]
   Subject       SPF include:sendgrid.net on example.com (spf_mechanism
                 example.com/include:sendgrid.net)
   Observed      spf1 (07:12, as anonymous): SPF includes senders through include:sendgrid.net maps
                 to sendgrid, absent from declared senders
   Observed      spf2 (07:12, as anonymous): SPF includes senders through include:sendgrid.net maps
                 to sendgrid, absent from declared senders
   Severity      low
   Why here      You listed google-workspace as sending for example.com.
   Fix           Confirm who owns and uses this sending service. Add it to mail.senders if intended;
                 otherwise remove its include after checking mail delivery.
